title: 青岚风云 第150章 魔道六宗偷袭林越对战黑袍人青岚风云 第149章 六宗传来消息长城主体建成
slug: 凡人修仙我能无限重生
content_zh:
青岚风云第150章魔道六宗偷袭，林越对战黑袍人
几日后。
天空下起了霏霏细雨。当天夜里，一名值守弟子低头检查一株嵌进墙体的灵晶节点。
忽然间，一团黑云在天边袭来。
他抬起头来，仔细看了片刻，顿时大惊失色。
那不是什么黑云，而是一片正在快速靠近的人群。密密麻麻，像一片正在移动的潮水。
“有情况！”
那名弟子刚喊出声，一道暗红色的流光便从他身侧的城墙掠过，“轰”的一声，炸在他身后数步远的地方，碎石飞溅，火光迸裂。
那名弟子被气浪掀翻在地，还没来得及起身，便被另一道流光击中，整个人倒飞出去，撞在身后的墙垛上，闷哼一声便不再动弹。
好在他的叫声已经惊动了其他弟子。大家陆续从帐篷中奔出来。只见数百名穿着灰黑色衣袍的魔修，正借助夜色和灌木的掩护，分三路朝城墙冲杀过来。
他们的动作整齐利落，像是早已摸清了整段城墙的布防薄弱点。不到片刻，便已杀到城墙之下，危机一触即发。
林越听到那声轰鸣，几乎同时，他的身影从帐篷冲到城墙上。看到黑压压冲杀而来的魔修，他冷哼一声，沉声道，
“终于来了。”
他早就料到魔道六宗不可能会任由他们修筑正气长城，他等这一刻已经等了很久很久，他的表情没有太多惊慌，反而还有种久违的兴奋感。
“传讯各段！”
林越的声音在夜风中响起。
“有敌袭！全体上墙！”
他话音未落，城墙上的灯火便一盏接一盏地亮起来。
值守的弟子们点燃了预先埋好的示警符阵，将整段长城照得如同一条被点燃的火龙。
营地中的弟子和民夫们抓起武器，纷纷朝着城墙上奔去。有些还在睡梦中便被吆喝声吵醒，也不知道发生了什么，便睡眼惺忪的跟着人群跑到城墙上。

短短片刻，墙体上便站满了人影。
“林长老，什么情况？是魔道六宗攻来了？”
李长老快步来到林越身边，望着城墙下黑压压的人影问。
“嗯。他们来得正好，免得麻烦我去找他们。”林越拔出四象剑，做好了应敌准备。
魔道攻势来得极快。
突袭北坡的是血煞宗的一支精锐，他们当中至少有十几人是筑基期修为，手中使得是一柄暗红色的长刀，刀锋每一次劈落，都会在墙面上留下一道深及半尺的裂痕。
“可惜，你们来得太迟了。正气长城已经建造的差不多了，你们这时候才赶过来，简直就是送死。”
林越见魔道妖人被挡住城墙外，脸上不由得一阵冷笑。
“别让他们靠近灵晶节点！”
content_en:
Qinglan Fengyun Chapter 150 Six Demonic Sects sneak attack, Lin Yue fights against the man in black robe
A few days later.
It began to drizzle in the sky. That night, a disciple on duty lowered his head to inspect a spiritual crystal node embedded in the wall.
Suddenly, a black cloud came over the horizon.
He raised his head and looked at it carefully for a moment, and was suddenly shocked.
It was not a black cloud, but a group of people approaching quickly. Densely packed, like a moving tide.
"There's a situation!"
As soon as the disciple shouted, a dark red stream of light passed by the city wall beside him, and with a "boom", it exploded a few steps behind him, causing gravel to fly and fire to burst out.
The disciple was knocked to the ground by the air wave. Before he could get up, he was hit by another stream of light. He flew backwards and hit the wall behind him. He groaned and stopped moving.
Fortunately, his cry had already alerted the other disciples. Everyone ran out of the tent one after another. Hundreds of demonic cultivators wearing gray and black robes were seen charging towards the city wall in three groups using the cover of the night and shrubs.
Their movements were neat and tidy, as if they had already figured out the weak points of the entire city wall. In less than a moment, they were already under the city wall, and the crisis was imminent.
Lin Yue heard the roar, and almost at the same time, his figure rushed from the tent to the city wall. Seeing the demonic cultivators rushing towards him in a dark way, he snorted coldly and said in a deep voice,
"It's finally here."
He had long expected that the Six Demonic Sects would not allow them to build the Great Wall of Righteousness. He had been waiting for this moment for a long, long time. His expression did not show much panic, but rather a sense of excitement that he had not seen for a long time.
"Call each paragraph!"
Lin Yue's voice sounded in the night wind.
"There is an enemy attack! Everyone go to the wall!"
Before he finished speaking, the lights on the city wall lit up one after another.
The disciples on duty lit the pre-buried warning talisman array, illuminating the entire section of the Great Wall like a ignited fire dragon.
The disciples and civilians in the camp grabbed their weapons and ran towards the city wall. Some were woken up by shouts while they were still sleeping. Not knowing what happened, they followed the crowd sleepily to the city wall.
In just a short moment, the wall was filled with figures.
"Elder Lin, what's going on? Is the Six Demonic Sects attacking?"
Elder Li quickly came to Lin Yue's side, looking at the dark figure under the city wall and asked.
"Yes. They came just in time to save me the trouble of looking for them." Lin Yue pulled out the Four Elephant Sword and got ready to fight the enemy.
The demonic attack came very quickly.
The ones who raided the north slope were an elite group of Blood Evil Sect. At least a dozen of them were in the foundation-building stage. They held a dark red long knife in their hands. Every time the blade struck, it would leave a crack half a foot deep on the wall.
"It's a pity that you arrived too late. The Great Wall of Righteousness has almost been built, and if you rush here just now, you are simply sending yourself to death."
Lin Yue couldn't help but sneer on his face when he saw the demonic demon being blocked outside the city wall.
"Don't let them get close to the spiritual crystal node!"
